name: Ray-Unit Parallel Marching Cubes
definition: An enhanced MC algorithm on a CPU/GPU heterogeneous architecture that uses ray units to reduce repeated computations, preserves unique surface intersection indices to embed topological information, and parallelizes I/O and computation across multiple CPU processes and GPU threads.
summary: Ray-Unit Parallel Marching Cubes replaces standard voxels with ray units to eliminate redundant edge calculations and embed topological connectivity directly into triangle composition.
